about: The grid's rule, stated once for both implementations: core/services/timetable_slot_config.is_on_grid (Python) and isPlacementOnGrid (static/js/page-timetable-workspace.js), whose renderer draws by the same cell key (cellKey). A meeting is drawn in a cell when its day is a teaching day and its start is a column start of its kind (a lab runs more than 80 minutes); an English bundle has its own table. Times read as the server reads them: H:MM or HH:MM in ASCII digits, seconds allowed, spaces (a no-break space too) around them ignored; the day upper-cased. Any other meeting is parked under its table.
